title: Portfolio book shows the instrument behind each holding

hosted_verification.statement: The hosted page was not verified in a browser by this task; this file records functional unit, contract-drift, i18n parity, typecheck, lint, production build, and local loopback Playwright fixture evidence only. Hosted deployment and live logged-in browser verification are owned by the downstream operator acceptance task INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.

ac1_instrument_columns_and_em_dash_fallb.detail: adaptPortfolioHoldingMonitorRow and adaptPortfolioHoldingRows in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts map instrument_id, instrument_kind/kind, contract_month, multiplier, margin_reserved/initial_margin_reserved, and reason_code onto PortfolioHoldingMonitorRow and HoldingRow (src/lib/v5/management/portfolio.ts). PortfolioBook.tsx and PortfolioExposure.tsx render Instrument kind (商品種類), Contract month (契約月), Multiplier (乘數), Margin reserved (保留保證金), and Reason code (決策原因) columns with an em dash ('—') when any field is absent or null, while existing cash share rows render Holding, Quantity, Avg entry, Last close, Market value, and Unrealized PnL identically to FE-HOLDINGS-COST-PRICE-COLUMNS-20261106.

ac2_bff_market_value_and_unrealized_pnl_.detail: Market value and unrealized PnL per row are read directly from BFF row.marketValue and row.unrealizedPnl without recomputing quantity * price in the browser. PortfolioBook.test.tsx, PortfolioExposure.test.tsx, and e2e/20-portfolio-book-monitor.spec.ts assert that a stock_future row (ssf:QFF:202611) with quantity 2, mark_price 2250, average_price 2300, and multiplier 100 displays the BFF market_value NT$450,000 (not NT$4,500) and BFF unrealized_pnl -NT$10,000 (-2.17%).

ac3_locale_labels_i18n_parity_and_contra.detail: Both src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts define mgmt.portfolio.instrumentKind ('Instrument kind' / '商品種類'), mgmt.portfolio.instrumentKindCashShare ('Cash share' / '現股'), mgmt.portfolio.instrumentKindStockFuture ('Stock future' / '股票期貨'), mgmt.portfolio.contractMonth ('Contract month' / '契約月'), mgmt.portfolio.multiplier ('Multiplier' / '乘數'), mgmt.portfolio.marginReserved ('Margin reserved' / '保留保證金'), and mgmt.portfolio.reasonCode ('Reason code' / '決策原因'). src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts and src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/contract-drift.test.ts pass with explicit assertions for all new keys and optional BFF fields.
